title: Chapter 7 Quiz
description: Test your mastery of physics simulation, collision, triggers, constraints, ragdolls, and Chaos destruction!

questions.question: What is the name of Unreal Engine 5's physics engine?
questions.explanation: UE5 uses Chaos, a new high‑performance physics and destruction engine.

questions.question: Which mobility setting is required for an actor to simulate physics?
questions.explanation: Movable actors can move; simulation requires mobility to be Movable.

questions.question: Simple collision shapes are preferred over complex collision for performance.
questions.explanation: Simple shapes (boxes, spheres) are much faster for physics and collision detection.

questions.question: Which collision response allows overlap and event firing without blocking?
questions.explanation: Overlap lets actors pass through and triggers events like BeginOverlap.

questions.question: Which preset should you assign to a trigger volume?
questions.explanation: The Trigger preset sets all responses to Overlap, ideal for volumes that only fire events.

questions.question: To debug collision shapes in the viewport, use the Show → _____ option.
questions.explanation: Show → Collision toggles visibility of all collision primitives in the level.

questions.question: Which event fires when an actor enters a trigger?
questions.explanation: BeginOverlap fires when two overlapping components start overlapping.

questions.question: A trigger volume blocks movement just like a wall.
questions.explanation: Triggers are set to Overlap, so actors pass through without collision blocking.

questions.question: What can you use to filter which actors trigger an overlap event?
questions.explanation: You can check Actor Tags or Cast to a specific class to filter.

questions.question: What must be true for a physics constraint to work?
options: Both actors have Simulate Physics enabled
questions.explanation: Constraints link rigid bodies; both must be simulating physics.

questions.question: Which constraint type limits rotation to one axis?
questions.explanation: Hinge constraint allows rotation around a single axis, like a door.

questions.question: What does a Slider constraint allow?
questions.explanation: Slider restricts movement to linear motion along a single axis.

questions.question: To make a constraint break under force, enable its _____ properties.
questions.explanation: Breakable settings allow the constraint to snap when force exceeds a threshold.

questions.question: What asset defines how a skeletal mesh ragdolls?
questions.explanation: The Physics Asset sets up collision bodies and constraints for each bone.

questions.question: How do you activate ragdoll on a character's skeletal mesh?
options: Set Simulate Physics on the mesh
questions.explanation: Use the Set Simulate Physics node (or property) on the skeletal mesh component.

questions.question: Physics Blend Weight allows mixing animation and ragdoll simulation.
questions.explanation: A blend weight between 0 and 1 interpolates between animation and physics per bone.

questions.question: Which Chaos asset type stores fractured mesh pieces?
questions.explanation: Geometry Collections contain the chunks and their connections for destruction.

questions.question: What is used to break a Geometry Collection at runtime?
questions.explanation: Physics Fields apply strain or force to break the bonds between chunks.

questions.question: You can trigger Chaos Destruction entirely within Blueprints.
questions.explanation: Nodes like Apply Radial Damage or Master Field work in Blueprints.

questions.question: Which collision shape should you use for complex meshes in physics?
questions.explanation: Simple shapes are much faster and stable for simulation.

questions.question: What does 'Sleeping' mean in physics simulation?
options: The object stops updating when it comes to rest
The object is paused by Blueprint
questions.explanation: Physics bodies sleep when their motion falls below a threshold, saving CPU.

questions.question: Which Blueprint node applies an instant push to a physics object?
questions.explanation: Add Impulse applies an instantaneous change in velocity, like a kick.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a physics constraint component?
options: To connect two actors and limit their relative movement
To add a sound to collision
questions.explanation: Constraints create joints like hinges, sliders, etc. between rigid bodies.

questions.question: In the context of ragdolls, what does 'Physics Blend Weight' of 0 mean?
questions.explanation: Weight 0 means the bone follows animation completely, no physics.

questions.question: Which tool do you use to fracture a mesh into pieces for Chaos?
questions.explanation: The Fracture Editor is used to generate chunks for Geometry Collections.
